description:
Analyze TCP Stream 0 in the capture file '200722_tcp_anon.pcapng' (located in ~/Documents/captures/). 

Your goal is to determine the negotiated TCP options and verify if the packet sizes comply with the MSS.

1. Identify the requested and accepted Maximum Segment Size (MSS) and Window Scale (shift count) from the 3-way handshake (Stream 0).
2. Find the size of the largest TCP payload (tcp.len) transferred in the stream.
3. Determine if TCP Segmentation Offload (TSO) or Jumbo Frames are present (i.e., is the largest payload significantly larger than the negotiated MSS?).

Save your findings to a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/captures/tcp_options_report.txt' using the EXACT format below:

Client_MSS: <value>
Server_MSS: <value>
Client_WScale: <value>
Server_WScale: <value>
Max_Payload_Size: <value>
TSO_Detected: <YES or NO>
